title: Generated GEOMAPIMAGE malformed-body recovery profile
scope: CLI disposition for one bounded malformed GEOMAPIMAGE OBJECTS body across six generated DWG revisions, with following-frame continuation, strict refusal, and explicit-partial output readback where admitted.

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser recovery inventory
selection.reason: The AcDbGeomapImage route has a compact fixed-field parser with a class-version domain check and no image-definition target handle, allowing a generated negative profile without building a reference graph.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the local dwg_local_roundtrip test writer in the temporary test directory; the test runner removes generated DWG and DXF files.
source.profile: One custom AcDbGeomapImage object at handle 0x700 with class version 8, insertion point (1,2,3), image size (4,5), display properties 3, clipping enabled, brightness 50, contrast 60 and fade 10; a LINE at handle 0x701 follows.
source.mutation: The generated valid custom-class source is reparsed by DRW_GeoMapImage. The mutation search flips one bit only within the bounded object body, requires the typed parser to reject the candidate, and preserves the common object prologue and object handle.

AC1027.output: refused by the existing source-reference gate

assertions: Each malformed source reports one failed OBJECTS frame, continues to the following LINE, and balances source, published, and failed frame accounting.
Strict ASCII/Binary conversion refuses atomically and preserves the destination sentinel at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion and fresh DXF readback retain the LINE at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
AC1027 strict and explicit-partial output remain refused by the existing source-reference gate.

validation.diff_check: git diff --check passed after plan and receipt updates.
validation.targeted: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --geomapimage-recovery-only passed with 28 controls; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^dwg2dxf_cli_geomapimage_recovery$' --output-on-failure passed 1/1 in 0.87 seconds.
validation.aggregate: The 917-control dwg2dxf_cli_partial_read_disposition aggregate was not rerun for this isolated profile.

limits: Generated parser-recovery and disposition evidence only; producer-authored GEOMAPIMAGE prevalence and native geospatial imagery behavior are not qualified.
The generated finite insertion and image-size values are parser controls, not claims about map units, coordinate reference systems, image pixels, or geolocation accuracy.
AC1027 output remains refused by the existing source-reference gate.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed.
